notice: Draft. This policy has been checked against the legal sources listed in our review and is waiting for the owner's approval. It is not in force yet.

clauses.title: 1. Who handles your payment and refund
clauses.text:
Our order process is conducted by our online reseller Paddle.com. Paddle.com is the Merchant of Record for all our orders. Paddle provides all customer service inquiries and handles returns.

So a refund on {{product.name}} is paid back by Paddle, to the payment method you used. We, {{business.name}}, decide the refunds described in this policy and ask Paddle to pay them. Paddle's own terms (https://www.paddle.com/legal/checkout-buyer-terms) also apply to your purchase.

clauses.title: 2. Free trials
clauses.text: If a plan has a free trial, you are not charged while it runs. If you cancel before the trial ends, you are never charged. The end date and the price after it are shown before you start and under Account > Billing.

clauses.title: 3. Our refund promise
clauses.text:
You can ask for a refund of a payment within {{legal.refundWindowDays}} days after it was charged. This covers the first payment and renewal payments. We approve the request unless there is clear abuse, such as repeated refunds of the same plan.

This promise is on top of the legal rights in section 5. It does not replace them.

clauses.title: 4. After the {{legal.refundWindowDays}} days
5. Your legal right to withdraw
clauses.text:
Some countries give consumers a right to cancel an online purchase within a short time, without giving a reason. This right stays as the law says. We do not take it away.

- EU, EEA, UK and Switzerland: 14 days from the day you buy.
- Korea: 7 days, under the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce.
- Some other countries have similar rights, for example Brazil, Canada and Singapore. The time differs by country.

For digital content and online services, the law in some places lets this right end once delivery starts, if you agreed to that. At checkout we show a notice and ask you to confirm it. Where the law does not allow the right to end this way, your right stays. Where a plan has a free trial, you can try the Service before you pay.

To use a legal right, follow section 7. You do not need to say why.

clauses.title: 6. Price changes and cancelling
clauses.text: If we raise the price of your plan, you can decline and cancel before the new price applies. You are not charged the new price (see "Price changes" in our Terms of Service (/terms)).

clauses.title: 7. How to ask for a refund
clauses.text:
Use one of these ways:

- Paddle's customer portal, from the link in your receipt or from Account > Billing;
- our Contact page (/contact), or {{business.email}}.

Tell us the email you used to pay, the date and amount, and the receipt number if you have it. We reply as soon as we can. When a refund is approved, Paddle sends it to your original payment method. How long your bank takes to show it is outside our control. The refund includes the tax charged on that payment.

Please ask us first before you ask your bank for a chargeback, so we can fix the problem faster.

clauses.title: 8. Changes to this policy
clauses.text:
If we change this policy, the change applies to purchases made after the new effective date. It never removes a right you had when you bought. This policy takes effect on {{legal.effectiveDate}}.

Questions: {{business.email}}, or our Contact page (/contact).
